Definition: Joel, the name of twelve Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Joel is named 19 times in the Bible, and the passages here are 1 Samuel 8:2; 1 Chronicles 4:35; 2 Chronicles 29:12. In 1 Samuel 8:2 we read, "Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abiah: they were judges in Beer-sheba." The same name belongs to more than one man, and 2 Chronicles 29:12 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Joel is brief in Scripture and long in God's memory, and that is my conviction. His name stands in the record, and that is enough for me.
RelatedPeople: Joel, Son of Samuel; Joel, Prince of Simeon; Joel, Son of Azariah
